links.outcome: Reading level (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT-4 patient education responses
links.effect: Most responses were written at a college reading level (median FKGL 15.4, IQR 14.4-16.6).
links.quote: Most responses were written at a college reading level (median and interquartile range [IQR] of FKGL score: 15.4 [14.4-16.6]).

links.outcome: Plain-language readability and understandability/actionability of ChatGPT-4 responses
links.effect: FKGL median 15.4 (college level); PEMAT understandability median 83% (IQR 70-92%); actionability median 60% (IQR 40-60%).
links.quote: The median of PEMAT for understandability was 83% (IQR: 70%-92%), and for actionability, it was 60% (IQR: 40%-60%).

links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy of ChatGPT-4 responses to patellar tendinopathy queries
links.effect: 16 (33%) of 48 responses rated accurate; only 17% of treatment-related questions received accurate responses; 75% comprehensive.
links.quote: Sixteen (33%) of the 48 responses were rated accurate, while 36 (75%) were rated comprehensive.

links.outcome: Semantic consistency of responses across different terminologies and over two months
links.effect: Median STS scores over two months and across terminologies were all ≥ 0.9.
links.quote: The medians of STS scores in the meaning of texts over two months and across terminologies were all ≥ 0.9.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4's baseline accuracy, comprehensiveness, and readability for patient-centered patellar tendinopathy queries without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
